senses.gloss: (cmp. טְרַד II) to bolt, tie, gird; to guard.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 35:3">Targ. Ps. XXXV, 3</cite>, v. <cite ref="I00738"><he>טרוקיתקא</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 86a:6">B. Mets. 86ᵃ</cite> <he>וטַרְקֵיה לבבא וכ׳</he> and bolted the door before him.
Erub. 102ᵃ דין לא נִטְרוֹק this must not bolt, i.e. with this bolt as it is you dare not bolt or unbolt. Part. pass. טָרִיק locked up.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 26:13">Targ. Job XXVI, 13</cite> (h. text <cite ref="B01255"><he>בָּרִחַ</he></cite>).
